Hello everyone! Welcome to my blog! I do have a tumblr blog but I don't reallty post anything on there plus I wanted to try using a custom blog. I am using a blog template made by nomnomnami. Here is a link to the templates: https://nomnomnami.com/templates/. Im using a template for now but eventually I'll make my own layout (if I ever get the energy for it).


I ended up making a program to automate making blog posts, puting the date, text, and tags for each blog post into json files and reading the files with javascript. I used KingPoss' NeoGallery script and edited it to fit my needs for this blog so I don't have to put everything into the html file for this page. It will keep the html clean and easy to edit and make changes. Its not perfect (it doesnt seem to like it when I put tables in the posts) but its at a point where I'm happy with it for now.


For now I'll post my thoughts, feelings, and my special interests on this little corner on my website! Hope y'all have a good rest of your day!
